Double burden of malnutrition


At the individual level, different forms of malnutrition can develop simultaneously or across the life course. While many LMICs
experience chronic undernutrition, individuals most commonly exposed to nutritional deﬁciencies now ﬁnd themselves in an obe-
sogenic environment, consuming a diet void of essential micronutrients, due to rapid population-level nutrition transition. It has
